text: Sunday brunch done right - the waffle arrived crisp at the edges with maple pooling in every pocket and berries actually fresh. Worth each minute.
Weekend brunch with the kids - shared one waffle then ordered a second, plus hot chocolates. Packed room but the team kept smiling.
Saturday brunch scene: cheese toast aur fries teen logon ne split kiye, bill bilkul sasta. Crowded but full vibes.
Bumped into the famous brunch crowd at this pink cafe and stayed anyway - filter coffee in a dabarah while the room hummed. Lovely chaos.
Saturday rush and they still made my usual exactly right. The place was packed and nobody's order seemed to suffer.
Brunch crowd at the door but takeaway was still five minutes. Croissant for the road, cappuccino for the drive. Efficient.
Ordered the waffle for a lazy Sunday in bed - arrived warm, maple packed on the side, berries not even bruised. Weekend made.
Came at opening, grabbed the corner before the brunch wave hit, and worked through the morning buzz. They never rushed me out.
Four of us, one crowded Saturday, zero drama. Pasta for the parents, fries for the kids, and staff found us the pushed-together table.
Brunch date at home: rose latte and strawberry cheesecake delivered - latte warm, cheesecake upright in its box. Partner took forty photos anyway.
Picked up eight sandwiches and six cold brews for a Saturday work session. Labelled, on time, every order correct despite the rush.
Sunday brunch vibe pe kulhad chai - crowd tha, energy thi, aur chai ekdum garam. Do ghante baithe full masti mein.
Chilli cheese toast delivered during peak brunch hour and it arrived still bubbling. Whatever their rider timing is, it works.
Brunch rush at brew and the staff still had time to tell me the rose milk story. Sabja seeds, chilled glass, pink everywhere. Charmed.
Avocado toast and matcha ordered in for a lazy weekend - toast still had crunch, matcha arrived warm. Slow Sunday sorted.
Kabir at the machine on a mad Saturday and my cappuccino still came with a heart on top. Cinnamon roll to share. Standard: kept.
Birthday brunch for my daughter - waffle stacked with berries, shake thick enough to need a spoon. The team made it feel special.
Weekend queue out the door but the counter line moved fast. Two minutes, perfect little shot, on my way.
Family Sunday lunch ordered in - pasta hot, hot chocolate untouched in its sealed cup, both arrived together. Rare reliability.
Hostel pe order kiya - iced latte aur peri-peri fries aaye ekdum thande aur crisp. Saara Sunday andar hi nikal gaya, no regrets.
Watched the waffle come off the griddle from our tiny table - crisp, golden, maple running into every square. Weekend ritual now.
Beat the brunch rush at opening, settled in by the window, and they let me stay even as the tables filled up. Grateful for that.
Quick takeaway amid the Saturday chaos. Counter was slammed but my order came out in minutes, exactly right. Machine-like crew.
Cheesecake delivered to my hotel after a long day out - slice perfect, glaze bright. Skipping the famous queue actually worked.
Ordered pasta home when we could not get a table - arrived hot in twenty minutes, kids approved, parents relieved. Backup plan works.
Cheese toast aur chai hostel mein manga liye - teen logon ne split kiya, sasta pada, Sunday sorted. Brunch bina crowd ke.
Cold brew and a blueberry muffin delivered for my Sunday paper ritual - cold, fresh, arrived before I had found my glasses.
Saturday brunch perfection: flat white, warm croissant, a two-seater by the window and the whole lazy morning ahead of us.
Fifteen drinks for a weekend volunteer meetup, every cup tagged by name. The brunch rush did not break their system at all.
Kids' weekend drinks ordered in - arrived warm and properly sealed. They call it 'the pink place'; even the delivery bag is stamped pink.
Rare slow Saturday for me - actually sat down instead of rushing and watched the brunch ballet behind the counter. Impressive operation.
Kids' weekend order - shake and fries arrived together, both at the right temperature. Even on their busiest day, no shortcuts taken.
Matcha delivered to my hotel mid-brunch-rush - tasted freshly whisked, arrived warm. Heard the queue was out the door; glad I ordered in.
Zoya ne pushed-together table bacha li jab hum chaar log aaye. Chai sabke liye order ki. This crew looks after its own.
Waffle and rose latte on a busy Sunday - both lovely. Only minus: a twenty-minute wait for a two-seater. Still smiling though.
Fries ne spot hit kiya brunch rush mein. Teen log thodi squeeze hokar two-seater pe baithe, but weekend hai - chalta hai.
Waffle and shake delivered for the kids' weekend treat - waffle still crisp, shake thick. Ran slightly late, the kids forgive them.
Flat white to go amid the weekend scrum - seven minutes instead of four, decent. Quality held even under the Saturday load.
Paneer tikka sandwich delivered during their peak - arrived warm, chutney still punchy, just ten minutes past the estimate.
Worked the early shift before the brunch crowd rolled in - steady wifi, calm room. By noon too loud for calls, but mornings are gold.
Saturday madness, but cup solid thi. Usual corner ek family of four ko mil gayi - unhe bhi brunch chahiye tha, no complaints.
Filter coffee and cheesecake during the weekend rush. Delicious both, though the buzzing room is more lively than relaxed.
Weekend pickup for the team breakfast - ten items, all correct, though I queued fifteen minutes behind the brunch crowd.
Cheese toast badhiya tha, mahaul Saturday ko full pada tha. Table ke liye wait karna pada but food ne compensate kar diya.
Cinnamon roll reached warm with the icing intact, even mid-brunch-rush. Deduct a little for the flattened box corner.
Avocado toast delivered for a slow Sunday - arrived neat, chilli crunch still fresh. Box slightly dented, contents perfect.
Food good, kids happy. The queue stressed the little ones a bit, but the staff kept checking on us the whole wait.
Sunday ka usual to go. Counter crowded tha but they called names in order and got mine right. Reliable even in the crush.
Group study brunch - sab kuch sahi tha, bas do logo ke liye table thodi choti padi. Weekend ka scene hai, expected.
Waffle delivered in the lunch slot - still crisp, maple on the side. Rider took a while finding the gate but the food saved the day.
Tried both the rose milk and the rose latte on a packed Saturday. Rose milk wins for me. Room was heaving but the vibes were friendly.
Weekend lunch for the kids ordered in - hot chocolate and fries warm on arrival. Delivery slow at peak hour but forgiven.
Last free plug table mil gayi noon se pehle. Weekend afternoons ambience ke liye hain, spreadsheets ke liye nahi - drink steady thi.
Saturday delivery for a workshop - all twelve items correct, sandwiches well packed. Slightly late, forgivable at that volume.
Usual order as silky as ever amid the brunch storm. Service ran a touch slower but everyone was clearly doing their best.
Grabbed a croissant for the road on a mobbed Sunday. The bag got a bit crushed at one corner but the pastry inside was unharmed.
Iced latte ghar mangaya Saturday ko - thandi, strong, perfect. Cafe ka loud music skip kar diya, price bhi same. Smart move.
Pasta arrived hot and saucy in the weekend slot. Portion felt slightly small for 330 but the taste absolutely carried it.
Rose latte on a packed Saturday, still made with obvious care. The queue to order ate ten minutes of my morning though.
No table free, so a waffle packed for a park picnic instead - stayed crisp in the box and the kids demolished it on the grass.
Masala chai and a cinnamon roll in a buzzing pink room. Crowded, cheerful, a little slow. Very Indiranagar, honestly.
Strawberry shake delivery mein bhi thick thi, weekend peak pe aadha ghanta laga aane mein. Taste ke liye worth the wait.
Cheesecake slice reached intact during peak hours - glaze perfect, base still firm. A touch late, but who minds on a Sunday.
Early drink before the brunch crowd - peaceful. Once the families rolled in it became headphone territory. Good place either way.
Split a waffle and two flat whites. Lovely morning, though watching others hover for tables adds a light guilt to the last bite.
Weekend team order: eight cappuccinos, six muffins, all present and labelled. Long queue to collect but the staff were organised.
The waffle itself was lovely, but forty minutes for a table and fifteen more for food on a Sunday tested our patience properly.
Cheese toast toh sahi tha par weekend crowd mein standing corner mein khana pada. Good food, zero seats, mixed feelings.
Pasta for the kids ordered in - arrived late and lukewarm on a packed Sunday. Tasted fine once warmed; the delay hurt hungry toddlers.
Weekend takeaway took twelve minutes instead of four. Cappuccino fine, but if I wanted to wait that long I would have sat down.
Brunch-time waffle delivery: an hour in transit, arrived warmish and slightly soft around the edges. The maple rescued it mostly.
The room becomes unusable at weekend brunch - chatter wall to wall and my calls went to voicemail. Drink was good; work, impossible.
Heard great things, but Sunday morning meant a thirty-minute queue and standing room only. The filter coffee was worth it, barely.
Usual order survived the brunch rush; my patience did not. Lost my table mid-order to a quicker group. Please sort the seating system.
Kids' order came late on a packed Sunday - drinks separated, snacks gone soft. Salvaged a rough afternoon, just barely.
Weekend bulk order arrived twenty-five minutes late with two croissants swapped for muffins. Tasty, but a client call ran coffee-free first.
Chai mast thi but do baje Sunday ko yahan aake khade raho - koi seat nahi mili. Aadha order khade hi khatam kiya.
Weekend delivery was slow and the fries softened on the ride over. Cheese toast still good. Order off-peak if you can manage.
Cheesecake ordered in on a busy Sunday - gorgeous slice, but the box arrived dented and tilted. Peak-hour service shows even in delivery.
Kids' drinks took over an hour by delivery and arrived just warm. Everyone had melted down by then. Peak-hour struggles are real.
Counter buried under brunch tickets, v chaotic. My drink was excellent when it finally appeared, twenty minutes after ordering. Weekend reality.
Took a rose latte to go when no seats freed up. Fifteen minutes for one drink; at least it was pretty and pink for the walk.
Family order at Sunday lunch: pasta great, shake half-spilled in the bag, forty minutes late overall. A properly mixed experience.
Fries crisp aur saste the but table ke liye itna wait kiya ki friends ne plan hi badal diya tha. Standing by the pastry fridge, ate anyway.
Usual order fine as always, but the Saturday scrum means no hello from the team anymore. I miss the calm weekday version of this place.
The room was a wall of brunch chatter and laptops-on-laps everywhere. Packed up after one hour. Weekdays only for me from now on.
Avocado toast ordered in on Sunday - arrived pretty but slightly soggy underneath, and the box was dented. Weekend overflow shows in delivery too.
Pre-ordered food for a Saturday event; pickup still took twenty minutes behind the brunch line. The food itself was spot on though.
Food was great once it landed on the table. Before that: thirty-five minutes standing, a crowded doorway, and hovering hopefuls everywhere.
Chai aur fries ne din bacha liya, but table ke liye itna lamba wait kiya ki poora group almost chala gaya tha.
Brunch with three kids: forty-five minutes standing, then told the waffle batter ran out. Kids cried, we left hungry. Manage the rush better.
Weekend takeaway should be faster than dine-in, not twenty minutes. The cappuccino was decent, which somehow makes the wait sadder.
Sunday lunch order arrived cold and late, pasta clumped together. Peak rush is no excuse when the order went in at noon sharp.
Waited forty minutes for cheesecake that turned out to be the last slice - dry edges, clearly sitting since morning. Overhyped place.
Sunday ko gaya, bheed itni ki chai bhi thirty minute mein aayi aur woh bhi adhuri garam. Weekend pe bilkul avoid karo.
Love this place on weekdays. Today: ignored at the counter ten minutes while groups pushed ahead, my order arrived wrong. Deeply disappointed.
Brunch crowd meant zero plugs, zero quiet, twenty minutes for a drink. Fine for a cafe date, useless for a work session. My bad, mostly.
Weekend order: waffle soggy in a steamy box, shake separated and warm, ninety minutes late. The photos online oversold this badly.
No free tables, kids' order forgotten twice. The fries finally came and were honestly great - a shame about literally everything else.
Avocado toast and matcha during brunch rush - ninety minutes late, toast soggy, matcha separated. The menu photography promised better.
Weekend bulk delivery: half the lattes arrived spilled into the carrier, order forty minutes late. Office floor smelled like coffee; the cups didn't.
Stood in a wall of weekend brunchers, espresso took twenty-five minutes, and my ticket got called under the wrong name twice. Pure chaos.
Cheese toast accha tha jab finally aaya, but chalis minute khade rehna cramped crowd mein student budget pe hurt karta hai.
Saturday order - latte leaked into the bag, croissant squashed completely flat. What stayed edible was nice. Packaging needs weekend-proofing.
Fifteen minutes for a takeaway cappuccino while the counter served delivery slips first, pls fix. Regulars get forgotten in the rush.
Rose latte delivered during peak - arrived cold, the syrup sunk at the bottom, cup lid loose in the bag. Pretty drink, poor journey.
Drove across town for the famous waffle. Forty-minute wait, then 'sold out'. Kids devastated. Put a sign up, save people the trip.
Twenty-eight minutes for a takeaway coffee on a Saturday. Counter could not find my ticket. Left empty-handed and late for plans.
Weekend order never fully arrived - missing the sandwich, fries cold and rubbery, support unhelpful. Money gone, lunch ruined.
Ek ghanta wait kiya, seat nahi mili, order garam nahi tha, aur bill pe attitude mila. Worst Sunday. Kabhi wapas nahi.
Saturday visit: regular order bhool gaye, cappuccino galat banke aayi, corner seat bhi gayi while I waited. Favourite cafe kho raha hoon.
Overrated spot. Waited in a chaotic crowd and the filter coffee came lukewarm and bitter. The pink walls cannot fix a broken queue.
Ordered pasta at 1 pm for a small birthday lunch. Arrived at 3, cold, sauce split, box dented. Party food became apology food.
No seat, no quiet inside the crowd, my order took twenty-two minutes. I pay for a workspace and got a mosh pit. Never again on weekends.
Saturday pickup for twelve people: order lost, remade half, croissants stale, filter coffee cold. Team breakfast effectively cancelled.
Cheesecake delivery promised by eight; arrived at nine-thirty crushed sideways in its box. Contacted support, got silence. Dreadful.
Kids waited an hour for their drinks by delivery - arrived separated and lukewarm. No apology via the app either. Sunday fail, total.
Takeaway fries ke liye half hour wait? Aur packet mein aadhi quantity bhi. Weekend rush ka matlab customer ko bhool jana nahi hota.
Weekend counter is a free-for-all - no queue, no order, thirty minutes of being overlooked entirely. Felt invisible in there.
Hot chocolate arrived stone cold, half spilled, on a Sunday evening. The cup looked like it had survived a flood. Refund, please.
